title: Update each source scraper using scrapling-skill
problem_statement: Only gtksa returns live data. svkoreans and ktown_koreadaily reach their sites but their selectors target outdated DOM. missyusa and radiokorea are configured with URLs that 404. The current scrapers also use BeautifulSoup glued onto scrapling Responses, contradicting the scrapling-skill guidance to use the native .css() / ::text / ::attr() API and making the scrapers brittle.
requirements: Each active source returns at least 1 live listing with {url, source_listing_id, title} from crawl_list_pages().
fetch_detail(url) returns non-empty HTML with HTTP 200.
Scrapers use scrapling 0.4.x native parsing API (.css(), ::text, ::attr(), .urljoin()); BeautifulSoup removed from extract layer.
All tests/unit/extract/test_*scraper*.py unit tests pass against regenerated fixtures.
Existing per-source parsers in transform/parsers/ continue to consume the HTML stored by fetch_detail() without changes.

decisions.radiokorea_fetcher: Switch from DynamicFetcher to Fetcher (server-rendered, no JS needed)
decisions.missyusa_fetcher: Keep StealthyFetcher (plain Fetcher hits TLS chain error in this environment)
decisions.fixture_strategy: Regenerate fixtures from small live snippets so fixture DOM matches live selectors

api_conventions: Response is itself a Selector; use response.css(...), response.urljoin(href), el.attrib, el.text, el.get_all_text() directly.
For fixture parsing offline, instantiate Selector(content=html_string).
response.html_content is the HTML string; response.body is bytes; response.status is the HTTP code.
prerequisite_fixes_already_applied: All 5 scrapers updated to use response.html_content (was .text/.bs4) and response.status (was .status_code)
base_scraper._detect_ban updated for new Response API
scripts/verify_scrapers.py created to test scrapers without DB/Redis

tasks.title: Add a selector-loading helper to BaseScraper and a fixture-loading helper to each scraper
tasks.objective: Give every scraper one code path for parsing live HTML or fixture HTML.
implementation_guidance: Add BaseScraper.parse_html(html: str) -> Selector that returns Selector(content=html, url=self._list_url).
Add BaseScraper._fixture_path(name: str) -> Path rooted at tests/fixtures/html/<source_name>/<name>.
Replace the silent 'except Exception -> fixture' block with one that calls logger.exception('live fetch failed for %s', url) first, then falls back to fixture only if the fixture file exists.
tests: Asserts _fixture_path resolves to existing files under tests/fixtures/html/.
tasks.demo: pytest tests/unit/extract/test_base_scraper_parse.py -q passes; helper is callable from a Python REPL with no source-specific code.

tasks.title: Modernize gtksa scraper to use the native scrapling API + regenerated fixture
tasks.objective: Refactor the working gtksa scraper to drop BeautifulSoup and use response.css(...), then re-confirm both live and fixture paths return >=3 listings. Proves the new pattern on a source that already fetches successfully.
implementation_guidance: Replace BeautifulSoup(...)/soup.select(...) with response.css("a[href*='wr_id']").
Iterate anchors, use response.urljoin(a.attrib['href']) for absolute URLs and a.text.strip() for titles.
Extract wr_id from the URL via re.search(r'wr_id=(\d+)', href).
Generate a new tests/fixtures/html/gtksa/list_page_1.html from a small live snippet (<=5 rows, stripped of unrelated chrome).
Keep _rows_from_fixture API but route through BaseScraper.parse_html.
tests: Update TestGtksaScraper.test_crawl_list_pages to assert len(listings) >= 3, every URL contains 'wr_id=', every source_listing_id is digit-only, every title is non-empty.
tasks.demo: pytest tests/unit/extract/test_remaining_scrapers.py::TestGtksaScraper -q passes; python scripts/verify_scrapers.py still shows gtksa as [PASS] with live data (real wr_ids).

tasks.title: Fix svkoreans scraper (selectors only - URL unchanged)
tasks.objective: Extract listings from the current Bootstrap responsive layout.
implementation_guidance: response.css('li.d-md-table-row') for rows.
For each row, row.css('a.na-subject') gives the title link.
Absolute URL via response.urljoin(href).
ID is the path tail: href.rstrip('/').rsplit('/',1)[-1].
Title is a.get_all_text().strip() (anchor wraps icon spans + text).
Regenerate tests/fixtures/html/svkoreans/list_page_1.html from a 3-listing live snippet that includes one row with the 'na-icon na-new' decoration so the title-extraction path is exercised.
tests: Rewrite test_svkoreans_scraper.py assertions: >=3 listings, every URL matches ^https://svkoreans\.com/rent_housing/\d+$, every source_listing_id is digit-only, titles are non-empty and Korean characters present.
tasks.demo: pytest tests/unit/extract/test_svkoreans_scraper.py -q passes; verifier shows svkoreans [PASS] with at least 5 live listings whose IDs all start above 1000.

tasks.title: Fix ktown_koreadaily scraper (selectors only - URL unchanged)
tasks.objective: Extract listings from the second .table_board_2 block where premium ads + main listings live.
implementation_guidance: response.css('a[href*="/ad_rent/rentview?data="]') is the simplest robust selector.
Title is a.css('.title2').get_all_text().strip() if present, otherwise a.get_all_text().strip().
ID is the data=NNNNN query param.
Deduplicate by URL (the same listing has both an image and text anchor).
Regenerate fixture as a 3-listing snippet of the second .table_board_2.
tests: Rewrite TestKtownKoreadailyScraper: >=3 listings, every URL contains '/ad_rent/rentview?data=', every source_listing_id is digit-only, no duplicate URLs.
tasks.demo: pytest -k Ktown -q passes; verifier shows ktown_koreadaily [PASS] with live data.

tasks.title: Fix radiokorea scraper (URL + fetcher in config, selectors in scraper)
tasks.objective: Switch to the desktop board URL, drop browser dependency, extract listings from .board_list li:not(.notice).
implementation_guidance: config/sources.yml - change url to https://radiokorea.com, path to bulletin/bbs/board.php?bo_table=c_realestate, fetcher to Fetcher.
Scraper - update _list_url to match.
response.css('.board_list li:not(.notice) a.thumb') gives listing anchors.
Title is a.css('h3::text').get('').strip().
Price is a.css('.price::text').get('').strip() (kept for parser).
ID is wr_id query param.
URL is response.urljoin(href) (note: relative '../bbs/...' resolves against the list URL).
Regenerate fixture from a 3-listing snippet (skip notice rows).
Update class attribute fetcher_type = 'Fetcher'.
tests: Rewrite TestRadiokoreaScraper: >=3 listings, every URL absolute and on radiokorea.com, every URL contains 'wr_id=', every title non-empty.
tasks.demo: pytest -k Radiokorea -q passes; verifier shows radiokorea [PASS] with live data; no Playwright launches in the run logs.

Use BeautifulSoup-free path.

Note: live verifier may take longer because StealthyFetcher launches Playwright - bump verifier per-source timeout if needed.
tests: Rewrite TestMissyusaScraper: >=3 listings, every URL contains 'board_read.asp', every URL contains 'idx=', every title non-empty.
